Cyberdefense Expert

Saint-Ouen, Île-de-France
Apply now
Back
Permanent
Île-de-France
Saint-Ouen
Tech
Full - Time
02-Jun-2026

Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!

For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.

Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,400 tech people and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.

Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.

 

LET US INTRODUCE YOU THE TEAM!

 

Join the CyberDefense Center of L’Oréal and reinforce our BUILD and CONTINUOUS improvement team!

Our team needs to innovate continuously to ensure the worldwide security of L’Oreal from the growing number of harmful cyberattacks.

The team is key to reach this target and improve the DETECTION and REACTION capabilities while being align with the L’Oreal Beauty tech transformation.

We also want to accelerate the integration of CUTTING-EDGE and AI technologies to protect L’Oreal.

Interact closely with our security teams in an international context. 

More a team, we are full of benevolence, you will for sure meet a second family. 

 

INTERESTED?

THIS IS WHAT YOU WILL DO IN NUTSHELL!

We can summarize your missions in several missions:

  • Contribute as an expert to the development and roll-out of theCyberdefenseroadmap
  • Challenge our current detection and response capabilities
  • Analyze cyber-attacks, be part of our purple team, and drive an improvement plan

 

IF YOU WANT TO GO FURTHER IN DETAILS, THIS IS WHAT YOU COULD EXPECT TO DO

  • Technical contact for the Cyberdefense roadmap
  • Propose detection solutions and processes in line with the L'Oreal ecosystem
  • Challenges Cybersecurity partners and current detection capabilities
  • Implements detection rules on tools (SIEM, EDR, Cloud, etc.)
  • Implements automation workflows on tools (SOAR, EDR, Cloud, etc.) 
  • Accelerate with AI / ML functionalities on L'Oreal's security solutions.
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of solutions based on real security incidents, redteam, etc...
  • Test new Cyberdefense solutions and participate in their set-up.

 

STILL INTERESTED?

THIS IS WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED!

 First and foremost, we love people that are curious, collaborative, eager to have an impact, proactive and who value innovation, autonomy, and team spirit.

Secondly, in this specific position, it will be important for you to have:

 

Mandatory skills:

  • Knowledge and experience in IT Security Technologies 
  • Detection and automation engineering 
  • Knowledge and experience in Infrastructure (cloud included)

 

Nice to have skills:

  • Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (NIST, OWASP, MITRE)
  • Knowledge in Cyberdefense strategy and tools
  • Knowledge of public cloud services 
  • Knowledge of web technologies (API, application security, …)
  • Experience in CERT / CSIRT / SOC ecosystem
  • Experience in infrastructure or cloud administration
  • Experience in coding (in particular in python will be appreciated)

 

LET US GIVE YOU 6 OTHER REASONS TO JOIN US!

Joining L'Oréal means joining a company that:

  1. Invests in Techand positions its Tech teams at the heart of its digital transformation strategy.
  1. Allows its employees to have areal impact, to test their ideas, to innovate and to build our future.
  1. Offers a Hybrid Work Policy: 3 Days in Office, 2 Days Work from Home
  1. Provides many benefits: VIP staff shop offering our products at a preferential rate, a company restaurant & gym, 60% reimbursement of transportation subscription, a work council offering lots of employee discounts (social & cultural activities, holiday vouchers etc.) and much more!
  1. Delivers a powerful and innovative HR policy: dynamic mobility policy, significant investment in employee training, regular re-evaluation ofremuneration, numerous innovative HR measures: Time Savings Account, paternity leave, Citizen Day, etc.
  1. Is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in a diverse environment. We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and we do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That’s the beauty of L’Oréal.


GOOD TO KNOW: THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS 

  1. Interview with HR
  1. Interview with the hiring manager
  1. Interview with the business leader

We will be delighted to exchange with you!
